_help: Vetted libraries for `lune run kit add <name>`. Every entry was checked (two sources, license, maintainer, source scan) and logged in VETLOG.md before it was added here. Versions are pinned; bump only after re-vetting.

profilestore.about: player data saving with session locking — no lost or duplicated items (by loleris; NOT the 2jammers copy)
profilestore.usage:
local ProfileStore = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService").ServerPackages.ProfileStore)
local Store = ProfileStore.New("PlayerData", { Coins = 0, Inventory = {} })
-- on PlayerAdded: local profile = Store:StartSessionAsync(`{player.UserId}`, { Cancel = function() return player.Parent ~= Players end })
-- profile.Data.Coins += 10 (server only); on PlayerRemoving: profile:EndSession()

trove.about: cleanup of connections, instances and threads in one place — prevents memory leaks
trove.usage:
local Trove = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Packages.Trove)
local trove = Trove.new()
trove:Connect(part.Touched, onTouch)
trove:Add(Instance.new("Part"))
-- later: trove:Destroy() disconnects and destroys everything it holds
